extensionDescription.message: A browser extension to clip web content, organize materials, and create simple video sequences.
extensionDescription.description: A short description of the extension.

toggleEditModeButtonText.description: Text for the button that toggles page editing mode.

toggleSidebarButtonText.description: Text for the button that shows/hides the sidebar.

clipSelectionButtonText.description: Text for the button that clips the selected text on the page.

sidebarHeader.description: Main header for the sidebar, often same as extension name.

closeButtonText.description: Text for the close button inside the sidebar.

clipsTabButtonText.description: Text for the 'Clips' tab button in the sidebar.

editorTabButtonText.description: Text for the 'Editor' tab button in the sidebar.

clipsViewHeader.description: Header for the area displaying saved clips.

mediaBinHeader.description: Header for the media bin in the editor tab.

timelineHeader.description: Header for the timeline area in the editor tab.

saveTimelineButtonText.description: Text for the button to save the current timeline.

aiVideoIntentPlaceholder.message: Optional: Video theme or style (e.g., funny, educational)
aiVideoIntentPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text for the AI video intent input field.

sendToAiButtonText.description: Text for the button to trigger AI video generation.

statusTextClipped.description: Status message shown when text is successfully clipped.

statusImageClipped.description: Status message shown when an image is successfully clipped.

statusNoTextSelected.description: Status message shown when trying to clip text but none is selected.

statusNoImageUrl.message: No image URL provided for clipping.
statusNoImageUrl.description: Status message if image URL is missing for clipping.

statusTimelineSaved.description: Status message shown when the timeline is successfully saved.

statusAiPayloadLogged.description: Status message shown when the AI payload is prepared and logged.

statusTimelineEmpty.message: Timeline is empty. Add some clips!
statusTimelineEmpty.description: Status message shown when trying to use an empty timeline.

statusErrorLoadingClips.description: Status message shown if there's an error loading clips from storage.

statusErrorSavingClip.description: Status message shown if there's an error saving a single clip.

statusErrorDeletingClip.description: Status message shown if there's an error deleting a clip.

statusErrorLoadingTimeline.description: Status message shown if there's an error loading the timeline from storage.

statusErrorSavingTimeline.description: Status message shown if there's an error saving the timeline to storage.

statusErrorLoadingMediaBin.description: Status message for error loading media bin items.

clipImageContextMenuLabel.description: Text for the context menu item to clip an image.

noClipsYetMessage.message: No clips yet. Select text or right-click an image to clip!
noClipsYetMessage.description: Message shown in the clips view when no clips are saved.

mediaBinEmptyMessage.message: Media bin empty. Add clips from the 'Clips' tab or by clipping new content.
mediaBinEmptyMessage.description: Message shown in media bin when empty.

timelineEmptyMessage.message: Timeline is empty. Drag items from Media Bin.
timelineEmptyMessage.description: Message shown in timeline when empty.

deleteButtonSymbol.description: Symbol or text for delete buttons. 'X' is common.

timelineItemDurationSuffix.description: Suffix for duration input, e.g., '5 s' for 5 seconds.

statusClipDeleted.description: Status message shown when a clip is successfully deleted.

popupTitle.description: Title for the browser action popup.
